summary: AnsibleVaultEncryptedUnicode is replaced by EncryptedString; vaulted values now appear as tagged str and need no special handling, so isinstance checks for the old type stop matching.
questions: Why does my isinstance check for vault values no longer work?
How do I read a vaulted value in a plugin in ansible-core 2.19?

answer_card.title: AnsibleVaultEncryptedUnicode replaced by EncryptedString
answer_card.answer_md:
`AnsibleVaultEncryptedUnicode` has been replaced by `EncryptedString`. Code that creates the old type gets `EncryptedString` instances, for compatibility.

`isinstance` checks for `AnsibleVaultEncryptedUnicode` will no longer match; those values now appear as a **tagged `str`**, and no special handling is needed to read them.
